text_block_list.text:
This is very cute.
It feels nice to hold, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It reminded me of the teddy bear
my parents gave me when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I could have some sent from home
and display them together with this one.
